make interaction model for examples

Source: R/simulate_LFQ_data.R
sim_make_model_lmer.Rd

make interaction model for examples

Usage

sim_make_model_lmer(
  model = c("parallel2", "parallel3", "factors", "interaction"),
  singular = FALSE
)
